starting-off.text: This guy seems a little down on his luck. Do you want to help him?

steps.text: Torn clothes, covered in bruises and cuts...  This man must have been down here a long time.
He seems to have a pulse.
And he's definitely breathing, although very weakly.
Let's have a closer inspection of this man.
The following screen will show you the man's stats. You can find out more information by clicking on the stat names. His stats will need improving to the bar markers to progress.
As you turn away, you feel a pang of guilt. Shouldn't you help this poor fellow?

starting-off-after-closing-the-interface.text: You can access this interface any time by selecting the 'Inspect' option on the man.

starting-off-talking-to-the-fallen-man.text: No good. He still seems to be critically wounded. You had better improve his stats.

recovery-using-inedible-items-on-him.text: You can only use edible food on him.

recovery-using-edible-items-on-him.text: You manage to feed him. He seems to like it.

recovery-feeding-him-something-he-recent.text: The man rejects the food. It seems he would rather some variety.

recovery-waking-up.text: The man takes the food. He seems to enjoy it and opens his eyes.

recovery-waking-up.player: You'll be okay. You'll be fine.

spirit-checkpoint-reached.text: Continues below with a random conversation

spirit-possible-conversations.text: Various possible conversations can happen depending on his spirit level. Name changes from Fallen Man to Cyrisus after learning his name.

steps.player: Just don't worry.

steps.speaker: Fallen Man
steps.text: You think things will turn out okay?

steps.player: Well...
Of course.

steps.speaker: Fallen Man
steps.text: Oh thanks, I feel a bit better now.

options.text: Well, probably not, to be honest.

steps.player: Well, probably not, to be honest.

steps.speaker: Fallen Man
steps.text: I thought so. I'm doomed!

options.text: I'm going to have to go soon.

steps.player: I'm going to have to go soon.

steps.speaker: Fallen Man
steps.text: Oh no, please don't leave me alone!

steps.player: Sorry, I have work to do.

steps.speaker: Fallen Man
steps.text: I don't think I will survive much longer.

steps.player: It's quite dark down here.

steps.speaker: Fallen Man
steps.text: I hadn't noticed. Who knows what danger lurks in the shadows. I'm so scared.

options.text: I wonder what monster carved this cave out?

steps.player: I wonder what monster carved this cave out?

steps.speaker: Fallen Man
steps.text: Monster? What monster?

steps.player: Oh, erm, never mind.
Did you hear that noise?

steps.speaker: Fallen Man
steps.text: What!

steps.player: I thought I heard something...

steps.speaker: Fallen Man
steps.text: Oh no, they're coming to get us!

steps.player: No, it's okay. I must have been imagining things.
You're looking better now.

steps.speaker: Fallen Man
steps.text: You're lying. I look dreadful.

steps.player: No, honest.

steps.speaker: Fallen Man
steps.text: Really? In what way?

options.text: You don't look dead any more, for a start.

steps.player: You don't look dead any more, for a start.

steps.speaker: Fallen Man
steps.text: Well it's a start, I suppose. Doesn't sound too promising.

options.text: Well, you look and sound more lively.

steps.player: Well, you look and sound more lively.

steps.speaker: Fallen Man
steps.text: That's promising. Perhaps I will make it out of here.

options.text: How long have you been down here?

steps.player: How long have you been down here?

steps.speaker: Fallen Man
steps.text: I don't know, probably days. I just can't remember.

steps.player: That's quite terrible.

steps.speaker: Fallen Man
steps.text: I know.

options.text: This place gives me the creeps!

steps.player: This place gives me the creeps!

steps.speaker: Fallen Man
steps.text: Me too. I'm so scared. Please don't leave me.

steps.player: I'm afraid I shall have to soon.

steps.speaker: Fallen Man
steps.text: Oh no.

steps.player: Feeling positive?

steps.speaker: Fallen Man
steps.text: Not really.

steps.player: Oh.

options.text: Are you looking forward to getting out?

steps.player: Are you looking forward to getting out?

steps.speaker: Fallen Man
steps.text: Definitely. A good wash, fresh clothes, a nice meal.

options.text: Just take it a step at a time.

steps.player: Just take it a step at a time.

steps.speaker: Fallen Man
steps.text: Sorry, I was getting a bit over-excited there, I think.

steps.player: That's the spirit!

steps.speaker: Fallen Man
steps.text: Thank you, your help really is appreciated.

options.text: Why do you look so sad?

steps.player: Why do you look so sad?

steps.speaker: Fallen Man
steps.text: Wouldn't you if you were about to die?

steps.player: I imagine so.

options.text: Cheer up, it may never happen!

steps.player: Cheer up, it may never happen!

steps.speaker: Fallen Man
steps.text: True, I may never get out of here.

steps.player: Always so negative. It's not good for you!

options.text: Those are some deep cuts on your legs.

steps.player: Those are some deep cuts on your legs.

steps.speaker: Fallen Man
steps.text: Cuts? I hadn't noticed. Where?

steps.player: There, just above your shin.

steps.speaker: Fallen Man
steps.text: Oh no, oh no, oh no.

steps.player: Stop panicking!

steps.speaker: Fallen Man
steps.text: Easy for you to say!

options.text: I think I feel a bit ill.

steps.player: I think I feel a bit ill.

steps.speaker: Fallen Man
steps.text: Ill? You can't feel ill, I'm depending on you!

steps.player: I can't help being ill.

steps.speaker: Fallen Man
steps.text: Oh dear.

options.text: You seem like a nice guy.

steps.player: You seem like a nice guy.

steps.speaker: Fallen Man
steps.text: Ah, thanks. That's a really nice thing to say.

options.text: I thought I had better say it before it's too late.

steps.player: I thought I had better say it before it's too late.

steps.speaker: Fallen Man
steps.text: Oh, I see. I understand.

steps.player: Just being honest.

steps.speaker: Fallen Man
steps.text: Thank you. Right back at ya!

options.text: I can't believe how many suqahs are on this island.

steps.player: I can't believe how many suqahs are on this island.

steps.speaker: Fallen Man
steps.text: You're right. I really should never have come to this island.

steps.player: Perhaps you're right.

options.text: Don't you think you should give up being an adventurer?

steps.player: Don't you think you should give up being an adventurer?

steps.speaker: Fallen Man
steps.text: What makes you say that?

steps.player: Well, erm... you know.

steps.speaker: Fallen Man
steps.text: No, what?

steps.player: You don't seem to be doing too well at the moment.

steps.speaker: Fallen Man
steps.text: Thanks for the support, friend.

options.text: When we get out of here I'll buy you a drink!

steps.player: When we get out of here I'll buy you a drink!

steps.speaker: Fallen Man
steps.text: Really?

steps.player: Naturally.

steps.speaker: Fallen Man
steps.text: That's nice, what kind?

options.text: Whatever and wherever you want - my treat.

steps.player: Whatever and wherever you want - my treat.

steps.speaker: Fallen Man
steps.text: That's really appreciated. Thank you.

options.text: Something cheap. Although it's my pleasure, helping you is costing me.

steps.player: Something cheap. Although it's my pleasure, helping you is costing me.

steps.speaker: Fallen Man
steps.text: Okay. Fair enough.

options.text: Hope you don't mind me saying, but you smell a bit.

steps.player: Hope you don't mind me saying, but you smell a bit.

steps.speaker: Fallen Man
steps.text: I'm sorry.

steps.player: It's okay.

steps.speaker: Fallen Man
steps.text: No it's not, this is so embarrassing.

options.text: It'll be a while before we get out.

steps.player: It'll be a while before we get out.

steps.speaker: Fallen Man
steps.text: Oh no. I don't think I can stand much more.

steps.player: Well you have to. You just have to.

steps.speaker: Fallen Man
steps.text: Air. I wish I could breathe fresh air.

options.text: I'm very impressed you managed to get into this cave.

steps.player: I'm very impressed you managed to get into this cave.

steps.speaker: Fallen Man
steps.text: I must admit it was hard to crawl this far.

options.text: Did you not want to give up?

steps.player: Did you not want to give up?

steps.speaker: Fallen Man
steps.text: I suppose at times I did.

steps.player: I thought so.

options.text: I would have given up personally.

steps.player: I would have given up personally.

steps.speaker: Fallen Man
steps.text: Really? I was determined to survive.

steps.player: That's good!
Congratulations on not dying!

steps.speaker: Fallen Man
steps.text: Oh. Erm. Thanks.

options.text: Good job you didn't find more suqah down here.

steps.player: Good job you didn't find more suqah down here.

steps.speaker: Fallen Man
steps.text: I suppose so. But now that I think about it, I don't know why there are none down here.

options.text: I wonder why nothing lives down here.

steps.player: I wonder why nothing lives down here.

steps.speaker: Fallen Man
steps.text: I haven't really thought about it.

steps.player: It's probably not very easy to survive down here.

steps.speaker: Fallen Man
steps.text: Good point.

options.text: I trust you usually look smarter.

steps.player: I trust you usually look smarter.

steps.speaker: Fallen Man
steps.text: Yes, I am a bit scruffy at the moment.

steps.player: Just a bit.

steps.speaker: Fallen Man
steps.text: Sorry.

steps.player: Not to worry.

options.text: It's a bit damp in here.

steps.player: It's a bit damp in here.

steps.speaker: Fallen Man
steps.text: Is it? I suppose so. Why do you say that?

steps.player: Just concerned that it will make your condition worse.

steps.speaker: Fallen Man
steps.text: It wouldn't surprise me. I don't seem to be having much luck recently.

steps.player: Spider!

steps.speaker: Fallen Man
steps.text: Arrghh! Where?

steps.player: Just kidding.

steps.speaker: Fallen Man
steps.text: Oh, you scared me to death.

steps.player: You'll survive this easily.

steps.speaker: Fallen Man
steps.text: I'm not so sure.

steps.player: Come on. Think positive!

steps.speaker: Fallen Man
steps.text: What's the point?

options.text: Think of all the places you can visit when you get out!

steps.player: Think of all the places you can visit when you get out!

steps.speaker: Fallen Man
steps.text: That's true.

steps.player: Such possibilities and adventures!

steps.speaker: Fallen Man
steps.text: Yes. I can't wait!

steps.player: Because otherwise you'll fail.

steps.speaker: Fallen Man
steps.text: Failure...

steps.player: Yes. So you must think positive.

steps.speaker: Fallen Man
steps.text: I'll try, maybe when I feel a bit stronger.

options.text: I had better be going now.

steps.player: I had better be going now.

steps.speaker: Fallen Man
steps.text: Oh no please don't go.

steps.player: Why?

steps.speaker: Fallen Man
steps.text: Please.

steps.player: But why?

steps.speaker: Fallen Man
steps.text: I... I... need you to help me.

options.text: What are you going to do when you get out of here?

steps.player: What are you going to do when you get out of here?

steps.speaker: Fallen Man
steps.text: Well I don't know. What should I do?

options.text: That's up to you. You could travel with me!

steps.player: That's up to you. You could travel with me!

steps.speaker: Fallen Man
steps.text: You'd do that for me? That sounds marvellous! I will look forward to it.

options.text: If I were you I'd stay indoors.

steps.player: If I were you I'd stay indoors.

steps.speaker: Fallen Man
steps.text: You have a good point there.

options.text: Any chance you could pay me for this?

steps.player: Any chance you could pay me for this?

steps.speaker: Fallen Man
steps.text: Perhaps. Oh, but I don't think I have any money left on me.

steps.player: Shame.
It's very cold down here.

steps.speaker: Fallen Man
steps.text: Yes. Could you perhaps give me a blanket?

steps.player: No, sorry. I don't have any on me.

steps.speaker: Fallen Man
steps.text: I'll probably be okay. Thanks, though.

options.text: It's a good thing you have me to look after you.

steps.player: It's a good thing you have me to look after you.

steps.speaker: Fallen Man
steps.text: That is true.

steps.player: I rule!

steps.speaker: Fallen Man
steps.text: You ought to be careful with that attitude.

steps.player: No, I don't have to worry about anything because I'm the best!

steps.speaker: Fallen Man
steps.text: We'll see.

options.text: Not that I'm bragging or anything.

steps.player: Not that I'm bragging or anything.

steps.speaker: Fallen Man
steps.text: That's okay. I think you deserve it a bit for saving my life.

options.text: What would you do if I wasn't here?

steps.player: What would you do if I wasn't here?

steps.speaker: Fallen Man
steps.text: Probably be dead I suppose.

options.text: Quite the coincidence that I found you!

steps.player: Quite the coincidence that I found you!

steps.speaker: Fallen Man
steps.text: Yes, I think I've been very lucky.

steps.player: That you have.

options.text: So you don't know how long you've been down here?

steps.player: So you don't know how long you've been down here?

steps.speaker: Fallen Man
steps.text: No. Could have been days. I don't remember much after stumbling down the ladder: just crawling.

steps.player: That's quite scary.

steps.speaker: Fallen Man
steps.text: I know.

options.text: Not long now and you'll be back on your feet!

steps.player: Not long now and you'll be back on your feet!

steps.speaker: Fallen Man
steps.text: Oh, my friend, you really think so?

steps.player: That kind of depends.

steps.speaker: Fallen Man
steps.text: On what?

options.text: On whether we have to amputate your legs or not.

steps.player: On whether we have to amputate your legs or not.

steps.speaker: Fallen Man
steps.text: Amputate! You can't be serious?

steps.player: Ooops, erm, no I'm sure it won't come to that.

steps.speaker: Fallen Man
steps.text: Oh no. Why can't I die peacefully?

options.text: On whether you mind me helping you further.

steps.player: On whether you mind me helping you further.

steps.speaker: Fallen Man
steps.text: I'm so glad to have your help. I would never turn it down!

steps.player: I am glad.

options.text: Do you think there is anyone else down here?

steps.player: Do you think there is anyone else down here?

steps.speaker: Fallen Man
steps.text: Depends on what the person is like.

steps.player: Hmm, hopefully someone nice.

steps.speaker: Fallen Man
steps.text: Oh I do hope so!

options.text: You've got quite the collection of bruises there!

steps.player: You've got quite the collection of bruises there!

steps.speaker: Fallen Man
steps.text: I know. It hurts to move.

steps.player: They will mend in time.

steps.speaker: Fallen Man
steps.text: Time is something I don't have much of.

options.text: Since when did you only have one leg?

steps.player: Since when did you only have one leg?

steps.speaker: Fallen Man
steps.text: One leg! What the?

steps.player: Hahaha.
Just kidding.

steps.speaker: Fallen Man
steps.text: So mean.

steps.player: You look like I feel.

steps.speaker: Fallen Man
steps.text: And how do you feel?

steps.player: Pretty tired and dirty to be honest.

steps.speaker: Fallen Man
steps.text: Okay, I understand.

options.text: I'm tired, I think I'll take a nap.

steps.player: I'm tired, I think I'll take a nap.

steps.speaker: Fallen Man
steps.text: Now?

steps.player: Why not?

steps.speaker: Fallen Man
steps.text: Oh, no reason. Just thought you would help me out.

options.text: Do you think this cave is stable?

steps.player: Do you think this cave is stable?

steps.speaker: Fallen Man
steps.text: I'm not too sure. What do you think?

steps.player: I don't know, hence why I asked you.

steps.speaker: Fallen Man
steps.text: Oh. I hope it's safe.

steps.player: You're sounding much better.

steps.speaker: Fallen Man
steps.text: My voice, you mean?

steps.player: Yes, much more positive. Which is great.

steps.speaker: Fallen Man
steps.text: Thanks.

options.text: But you probably want to sort out the bad breath.

steps.player: But you probably want to sort out the bad breath.

steps.speaker: Fallen Man
steps.text: Oh, sorry.

steps.player: I'll let you off. But just this once.

options.text: If you need anything, just let me know.

steps.player: If you need anything, just let me know.

steps.speaker: Fallen Man
steps.text: Will do.

steps.player: You have a big appetite.

steps.speaker: Fallen Man
steps.text: I am hungry. Sorry for eating all your food.

steps.player: I'll let you off I suppose.
Let's sing a song!

steps.speaker: Fallen Man
steps.text: Is it really the time to?

steps.player: Half a pound of tuppenny rice, half a pound of treacle.

steps.speaker: Fallen Man
steps.text: But...

steps.player: That's the way the money goes. Pop goes the weasel!

steps.speaker: Fallen Man
steps.text: Please go away...

steps.player: It's quite cosy in here.

steps.speaker: Fallen Man
steps.text: That's a strange thing to say.

options.text: The perfect environment for getting back on your feet!

steps.player: The perfect environment for getting back on your feet!

steps.speaker: Fallen Man
steps.text: Not sure I agree, but thanks for thinking of me.

steps.player: All part of the service.
You don't like it?

steps.speaker: Fallen Man
steps.text: No, not really.

steps.player: There's no pleasing you, is there?
How about a joke!

steps.speaker: Fallen Man
steps.text: Please, I don't...

steps.player: How does the queen bee get around her hive?

steps.speaker: Fallen Man
steps.text: Okay, go on.

steps.player: She's throne.

steps.speaker: Fallen Man
steps.text: That was bad.

options.text: This would probably make a nice home.

steps.player: This would probably make a nice home.

steps.speaker: Fallen Man
steps.text: You think?

steps.player: Yes, do you?

steps.speaker: Fallen Man
steps.text: Not really, I think I'll stick to living ABOVE ground.

options.text: We could do with something for you to sit on.

steps.player: We could do with something for you to sit on.

steps.speaker: Fallen Man
steps.text: Why?

steps.player: Well, I just thought it would be a bit more civil.

steps.speaker: Fallen Man
steps.text: You're a bit weird.

steps.player: Can you smell gas?

steps.speaker: Fallen Man
steps.text: Gas? Why would you smell gas?

steps.player: I just thought I could, you know... mines often have poisonous gases.

steps.speaker: Fallen Man
steps.text: Please, let's talk about something else.

options.text: You're very safe in this little cave.

steps.player: You're very safe in this little cave.

steps.speaker: Fallen Man
steps.text: I suppose I am.

steps.player: Just one entrance.

steps.speaker: Fallen Man
steps.text: Yes. Things could still get in here though.

steps.player: Nothing bigger than you or I.

steps.speaker: Fallen Man
steps.text: That doesn't particularly fill me with confidence.

options.text: The suqah will never fit through that tunnel.

steps.player: The suqah will never fit through that tunnel.

steps.speaker: Fallen Man
steps.text: Very true. I think I picked a good spot.

options.text: Let me tell you about myself.

steps.player: Let me tell you about myself!

steps.speaker: Fallen Man
steps.text: Oh, okay.

steps.player: I started off my life as a simple adventurer, battling goblins, picking up coins on the floor...
I remember the day when I was excited to find a thousand coins.
Now it is nothing!

steps.speaker: Fallen Man
steps.text: Sorry to stop you, but are you going to help me?

steps.player: Not a fan of stories, then? Fair enough.

options.text: What do you want to talk about?

steps.player: What do you want to talk about?

steps.speaker: Fallen Man
steps.text: I don't know, I don't think I feel like talking.

steps.player: Your loss.

options.text: Is it ok if I talk to you?

steps.player: Is it okay if I talk to you?

steps.speaker: Fallen Man
steps.text: No, I think I'd rather be left alone.

options.text: Tell me a bit about yourself.

steps.player: Tell me a bit about yourself.

steps.speaker: Fallen Man
steps.text: Me?

steps.player: Yes, you.

steps.speaker: Fallen Man
steps.text: Well, I grew up in Ardougne. Erm, I quite enjoy Fishing.

steps.player: Fishing?

steps.speaker: Fallen Man
steps.text: What?

steps.player: Sounds a bit boring to me.

steps.speaker: Fallen Man
steps.text: Don't knock it till you've tried it.

steps.player: Fishing!

steps.speaker: Fallen Man
steps.text: What?

steps.player: I like fishing too!

steps.speaker: Fallen Man
steps.text: Perhaps we can fish together one day?

steps.player: I'd love to!

spirit-reaching-food-and-spirit-threshol.player: I'm so pleased you're getting better! You must stay still though. You're not fit to walk yet.

spirit-reaching-food-and-spirit-threshol.speaker: Cyrisus
spirit-reaching-food-and-spirit-threshol.text: Where am I? Who are you?

spirit-reaching-food-and-spirit-threshol.player: My name's [player name]. You're on Lunar Isle, in a cave.

spirit-reaching-food-and-spirit-threshol.speaker: Cyrisus
spirit-reaching-food-and-spirit-threshol.text: I'm Cyrisus. Oh yes, I remember, I was on the island and...

spirit-reaching-food-and-spirit-threshol.speaker: Cyrisus
spirit-reaching-food-and-spirit-threshol.text: They attacked! I ran and ran. I crawled down here.

spirit-reaching-food-and-spirit-threshol.player: It's okay, it's okay. You're safe now.

spirit-reaching-food-and-spirit-threshol.speaker: Cyrisus
spirit-reaching-food-and-spirit-threshol.text: Oh my head hurts. And my legs. I'm so tired.

spirit-reaching-food-and-spirit-threshol.speaker: Cyrisus
spirit-reaching-food-and-spirit-threshol.text: Please, just leave me, I'm a waste of effort, my body is in ruin.

spirit-reaching-food-and-spirit-threshol.player: No, just trust me, I'll see that you get out of here. Don't give up.

spirit-checkpoint-reached-2.player: Hi there. How are you feeling?

spirit-checkpoint-reached-2.text: Continues above with a random conversation

spirit-using-edible-items-on-him-after-l.text: Cyrisus takes the food. He seems to enjoy it.

spirit-feeding-him-something-he-recently.text: Cyrisus rejects the food. It seems he would rather some variety.

spirit-using-food-on-him-after-reaching-.text: You don't need to improve Cyrisus's health any more.

spirit-reaching-both-thresholds-again.speaker: Cyrisus
spirit-reaching-both-thresholds-again.text: Thank you [player name]. I would surely be dead without you.

spirit-reaching-both-thresholds-again.player: Don't worry. So what were you doing on this island?

spirit-reaching-both-thresholds-again.speaker: Cyrisus
spirit-reaching-both-thresholds-again.text: Exploring. I greatly enjoy travelling the world and taking in all the experiences available.

spirit-reaching-both-thresholds-again.player: I can relate to that, and Lunar Isle is definitely worth a visit. Where else have you been?

spirit-reaching-both-thresholds-again.speaker: Cyrisus
spirit-reaching-both-thresholds-again.text: Well, I've travelled from the frozen wastes in the Wilderness to the pyramids of the Kharidian Desert. I've lived with the monkeys of Ape Atoll and dined with the TzHaar under the volcano of Karamja.

spirit-reaching-both-thresholds-again.player: Impressive. You must have a great many stories and mastered loads of skills.

spirit-reaching-both-thresholds-again.speaker: Cyrisus
spirit-reaching-both-thresholds-again.text: I could smith you full rune, farm spirit trees and still have time to cook you a summer pie for tea.

spirit-reaching-both-thresholds-again.player: Wow. No need to say more.
But why have you had such difficulty with the suqah? Surely you're a skilled warrior?
You must have mastered all forms of combat?

spirit-reaching-both-thresholds-again.speaker: Cyrisus
spirit-reaching-both-thresholds-again.text: Please, let's leave that line of conversation.

spirit-reaching-both-thresholds-again.player: Oh, okay. If you wish. So, what now?

spirit-reaching-both-thresholds-again.speaker: Cyrisus
spirit-reaching-both-thresholds-again.text: I still don't feel fit enough to go outside. I could also do with some armour.

spirit-reaching-both-thresholds-again.player: I suppose I could loan you some armour?

spirit-reaching-both-thresholds-again.speaker: Cyrisus
spirit-reaching-both-thresholds-again.text: Oh, there's really no need to worry.

spirit-reaching-both-thresholds-again.speaker: Cyrisus
spirit-reaching-both-thresholds-again.text: Trust, me, there's no need. Please, just go to the bank on this island, I have a friend working there. Just tell him I sent you.

spirit-reaching-both-thresholds-again.player: And what does he look like? What's his name?

spirit-reaching-both-thresholds-again.speaker: Cyrisus
spirit-reaching-both-thresholds-again.text: Trust me: when you see him, you'll know.

spirit-reaching-both-thresholds-again.speaker: Cyrisus
spirit-reaching-both-thresholds-again.text: Oh, and if you want, you can contact me with the Astral Contact spell in the Lunar Spellbook. It might save you running back and forth.

gearing-up-talking-to-cyrisus-again.prompt: What do you want to talk about?

steps.player: So you're in need of some armour?

steps.speaker: Cyrisus
steps.text: It would be good, yes. You should be able to talk to my friend in the bank on this island.
Continues above with a random conversation

gearing-up-astral-contacting-cyrisus.speaker: Cyrisus
gearing-up-astral-contacting-cyrisus.text: Hi! Managed to get my armour yet?

gearing-up-astral-contacting-cyrisus.player: I think I had best visit the bank and see what I can get.

gearing-up-astral-contacting-cyrisus.speaker: Cyrisus
gearing-up-astral-contacting-cyrisus.text: Well, I would appreciate it if you could hurry.

gearing-up-talking-to-birds-eye-jack.prompt: What would you like to talk about?

steps.player: Hi there, this may sound a bit random, but do you know Cyrisus?

steps.speaker: 'Bird's-Eye' Jack
steps.text: That I do. But I must say you seem quite familiar too.

steps.player: I do?

steps.speaker: 'Bird's-Eye' Jack
steps.text: Why! You're that insolent fool who insulted my navigational skills!

steps.player: What!

steps.speaker: 'Bird's-Eye' Jack
steps.text: Accusing me of navigating in circles!

steps.player: Wait a minute! Now I recognise you; you're the navigator on the ship that first took me to Lunar Isle! The first time I visited this place your navigation was useless!

steps.speaker: 'Bird's-Eye' Jack
steps.text: How dare you! It was a jinx.

steps.player: Ahh.
Of course.
Well, if it wasn't for me you would never have reached this place.

steps.speaker: 'Bird's-Eye' Jack
steps.text: Oh, behold the great adventurer [player name]. How the world would crumble without her.

steps.player: Oh, the wit.

steps.speaker: 'Bird's-Eye' Jack
steps.text: Better than yours.

steps.player: Er, no it isn't.

steps.speaker: 'Bird's-Eye' Jack
steps.text: Er. Yes it is.

steps.player: Er. No, it...
Stop. Let's not do that again. So, why are you working here now?

steps.speaker: 'Bird's-Eye' Jack
steps.text: Why, you have a problem with it?

steps.player: Oh no. It's just that the job of banker doesn't seem quite as... 'exotic' as 'pirate'. Seems like a step-down to me.

steps.speaker: 'Bird's-Eye' Jack
steps.text: How dare you! I'll have you know that the job of a banker is far more exciting than that of a pirate!

steps.player: Er, yeah, whatever you say mate.

steps.speaker: 'Bird's-Eye' Jack
steps.text: It is! And it's an honest living.

steps.speaker: 'Bird's-Eye' Jack
steps.text: I was tired of looting and hunting for treasure. It was time to turn my life around.

steps.player: What a heart touching story.

steps.speaker: 'Bird's-Eye' Jack
steps.text: Don't patronise me.

steps.player: Anyway, as I was saying, do you know Cyrisus?

steps.speaker: 'Bird's-Eye' Jack
steps.text: Yes.

steps.player: Well, he's down in the caves at the north of this island, and I need your help.

steps.speaker: 'Bird's-Eye' Jack
steps.text: Listening.

steps.player: I need to get some items out of his bank account. Is that possible?

steps.speaker: 'Bird's-Eye' Jack
steps.text: I suppose. Knock yourself out.

steps.speaker: 'Bird's-Eye' Jack
steps.text: I suppose you had better take this chest to carry his stuff. Don't want you losing any of it.
If the player's inventory is full:

steps.speaker: 'Bird's-Eye' Jack
steps.text: Ah, I would if you had any space.

gearing-up-withdrawing-unequippable-item.text: Cyrisus isn't going to want to wear that!

gearing-up-getting-a-new-chest-after-los.prompt: What would you like to talk about?

steps.player: Hello again. Could I access Cyrisus's bank account again.

steps.speaker: 'Bird's-Eye' Jack
steps.text: Okay. You best help him quickly or else I'll be after you!

steps.speaker: 'Bird's-Eye' Jack
steps.text: Ah, you can't unless you have the chest.

steps.player: Well, I'm afraid I have lost it.

steps.speaker: 'Bird's-Eye' Jack
steps.text: Well, I don't suppose it would be a problem to give you another. Here you go.

steps.player: Thanks!

gearing-up-looking-in-the-chest-while-it.text: Looking inside the chest, it contains absolutely nothing. I should visit 'Bird's-Eye' Jack at the bank to get it filled.

gearing-up-reopening-his-bank-with-the-c.prompt: What would you like to talk about?

steps.player: Hello again. Could I access Cyrisus's bank account again.

steps.speaker: 'Bird's-Eye' Jack
steps.text: Okay. You best help him quickly or else I'll be after you!
If the chest is in the player's bank:

steps.speaker: 'Bird's-Eye' Jack
steps.text: Ah, you can't unless you have the chest.

steps.player: Yes, I think I left it in my bank account.

gearing-up-showing-him-gear-through-astr.text: Dialogue varies depending on what items you put in the chest and what items he wants

gearing-up-showing-him-gear-through-astr.speaker: Cyrisus
gearing-up-showing-him-gear-through-astr.text: Hi! Managed to get my armour yet?

gearing-up-showing-him-gear-through-astr.player: I have got a chest and filled it with some items.
I'm glad you know what you want.

gearing-up-showing-him-the-correct-gear-.speaker: Cyrisus
gearing-up-showing-him-the-correct-gear-.text: Hi! Managed to get my armour yet?

gearing-up-showing-him-the-correct-gear-.player: I have got a chest and filled it with some items.
I'm glad you know what you want.

gearing-up-bringing-him-gear-in-person.text: Dialogue varies depending on what items you put in the chest and what items he wants

gearing-up-bringing-him-gear-in-person.prompt: What do you want to talk about?

steps.player: Hi, I've been to see 'Bird's-Eye' Jack, and I've got a chest.
I've also filled it with some armour; what do you think?

steps.speaker: Cyrisus
steps.text: Okay, I'll try it on. No peeking!

steps.player: Oh, I won't. I'll close my eyes.

steps.text: The screen turns black.

steps.speaker: Cyrisus
steps.text: Still changing.

steps.speaker: Cyrisus
steps.text: Hmmm....

steps.speaker: Cyrisus
steps.text: I've put the clothes back in the chest, they're not too bad.

steps.speaker: Cyrisus
steps.text: But not too good either. I need a different combination.

steps.player: Well, I'm confused, any tips?

steps.text: If he doesn't like any of the items:

steps.speaker: Cyrisus
steps.text: I can't stand the item of headgear you've chosen - get rid of that straight away!

steps.speaker: Cyrisus
steps.text: What's with the body armour? Totally not my style!

steps.speaker: Cyrisus
steps.text: I'd much rather have something else protecting my legs.

steps.speaker: Cyrisus
steps.text: The footwear has to go. I can't rely on them to help me.

steps.speaker: Cyrisus
steps.text: I'm not all that good at using the type of weapon you offered. Please bring something else.
If the items are all correct:

steps.speaker: Cyrisus
steps.text: Hmmm....

steps.speaker: Cyrisus
steps.text: Perfect! I couldn't ask for a better set-up!

steps.player: Excellent!

gearing-up-checkpoint-reached.text: Continues above with a random conversation

gearing-up-fully-restored.speaker: Cyrisus
gearing-up-fully-restored.text: Perfect! I feel healthy, I'm positively charged and I'm dressed like a war machine!

gearing-up-fully-restored.speaker: Cyrisus
gearing-up-fully-restored.text: Why thanks, I feel it too!

gearing-up-fully-restored.player: Why did you have such difficulty against the suqahs?

gearing-up-fully-restored.speaker: Cyrisus
gearing-up-fully-restored.text: Ah, well. Best I tell you. The thing is... the thing that I should say... the problem I have, for which you should know...

gearing-up-fully-restored.speaker: Cyrisus
gearing-up-fully-restored.text: I've tried so hard over the years, but I simply cannot gather the courage to fight monsters.

gearing-up-fully-restored.speaker: Cyrisus
gearing-up-fully-restored.text: I've learnt the techniques, I've got the equipment. I just get so afraid. My legs turn to jelly, I'm dripping with sweat. All I can do is run.

gearing-up-fully-restored.speaker: Cyrisus
gearing-up-fully-restored.text: I know it seems bad, but honestly, I've tried. It was part of the reason I came to Lunar Isle to see the Moon Clan. I trust you've gone through the ceremony to visit the Dreamland?

gearing-up-fully-restored.player: I have indeed. A very strange day I must say, but very valuable! Especially gaining the Lunar spells.

gearing-up-fully-restored.speaker: Cyrisus
gearing-up-fully-restored.text: Yes, so I came to the Moon Clan again to see if they could help me visit my dreams again and conquer my fear of combat. But then I came across the suqah.

gearing-up-fully-restored.speaker: Cyrisus
gearing-up-fully-restored.text: Say, would you come with me to the Oneiromancer? Perhaps you can give me some support or guidance?

gearing-up-fully-restored.player: Well, I suppose. Can't see why not.

gearing-up-fully-restored.speaker: Cyrisus
gearing-up-fully-restored.text: Excellent! Please, you go on ahead, I'll make my way there myself. I'm not walking out of this cave past those suqahs again!

gearing-up-talking-to-cyrisus-again-2.speaker: Cyrisus
gearing-up-talking-to-cyrisus-again-2.text: Of course! You just go speak with the Oneiromancer and I'll be right with you, faster than you'd think.

gearing-up-talking-to-birds-eye-jack-2.prompt: What would you like to talk about?

steps.player: Hi.

steps.speaker: 'Bird's-Eye' Jack
steps.text: How's Cyrisus? Where is he?

steps.player: He's fine now. Back to full health.

steps.speaker: 'Bird's-Eye' Jack
steps.text: Good, I'm pleased.

steps.player: No problem.

steps.speaker: 'Bird's-Eye' Jack
steps.text: Don't think that this means I like you now!

steps.player: Look at my face.

steps.speaker: 'Bird's-Eye' Jack
steps.text: Yes? What about it.

steps.player: Does it look like I care?

steps.speaker: 'Bird's-Eye' Jack
steps.text: Not really.

steps.player: Well, there you go.

dream-mentoring.speaker: Oneiromancer
dream-mentoring.text: Hello there. What do you want to talk about?

steps.player: Hello again.

steps.speaker: Oneiromancer
steps.text: Oh hello [player name]! It has been a while.

steps.speaker: Oneiromancer
steps.text: What brings you here again? Creating more astral runes?

steps.player: Not at the moment. I've come on behalf of a friend. You will probably have met him - his name is Cyrisus.

steps.speaker: Oneiromancer
steps.text: Oh yes, I know him. A bright man. What is it about him, my dear?

steps.player: Well, I...

steps.speaker: Oneiromancer
steps.text: Oh my.

steps.speaker: Cyrisus
steps.text: Hello!

steps.speaker: Oneiromancer
steps.text: Cyrisus. It's been a while. Your kind friend here was just talking about you.

steps.speaker: Cyrisus
steps.text: Good. We were hoping you could help us.

steps.speaker: Oneiromancer
steps.text: Yes? I can try.

steps.speaker: Cyrisus
steps.text: I need to get over my fear of combat. Surely I can sort that out in the Dreamland?

steps.speaker: Oneiromancer
steps.text: Of course. With the Potion of Shared Dreaming. It'll send you both into the Dreamland, and sort out your biggest issue.

steps.player: Sounds simple.

steps.speaker: Oneiromancer
steps.text: In most ways, yes. However, it will be dangerous.

steps.player: Why?

steps.speaker: Oneiromancer
steps.text: To get you into the dream together, the potion works by binding your subconsciousnesses together. The brazier has its own intelligence in interpreting your subconscious so it will understand your intentions when

steps.speaker: Oneiromancer
steps.text: placing you in the dream.

steps.speaker: Cyrisus
steps.text: Okay, I shall just take your word for that bit, but I still can't see the dangerous part...

steps.speaker: Oneiromancer
steps.text: With your minds melded as one, you need each other to survive. If one of you dies, you both die for real. Unlike before, you will die just as if you were killed by a monster in the wild.

steps.speaker: Cyrisus
steps.text: I'm not so sure about this anymore.

steps.player: Don't worry Cyrisus, we can do this. Oneiromancer, how do we make the potion?

steps.speaker: Oneiromancer
steps.text: Simple. I shall give you a vial, within which you should place water followed by one ground astral rune and goutweed. Then just use it on the brazier. Oh! You'll have to light it first, of course.

steps.player: Very well.

steps.speaker: Oneiromancer
steps.text: Good luck!

steps.speaker: Cyrisus
steps.text: Wait. Do we need to wear the clothes we had to wear to go to the dreamland before.

steps.speaker: Oneiromancer
steps.text: Oh no, no need. They were simply ceremonial clothes, you can wear whatever you want.

steps.player: Thanks.

steps.speaker: Cyrisus
steps.text: See you at the brazier!

dream-mentoring-talking-to-cyrisus-next-.speaker: Cyrisus
dream-mentoring-talking-to-cyrisus-next-.text: Hi [player name]. I must admit to being a bit nervous. Could you talk to the Oneiromancer? I want to get this out of the way quickly.

dream-mentoring-talking-to-the-oneiroman.speaker: Oneiromancer
dream-mentoring-talking-to-the-oneiroman.text: Hello there. What do you want to talk about?

steps.player: Hello.

steps.speaker: Oneiromancer
steps.text: How's it going?

steps.player: I'm still making the potion. Can you tell me what ingredients it takes again?

steps.speaker: Oneiromancer
steps.text: Water, an astral rune and goutweed.

steps.player: Thanks.

dream-mentoring-getting-a-new-dream-vial.speaker: Oneiromancer
dream-mentoring-getting-a-new-dream-vial.text: Hello there. What do you want to talk about?

steps.player: Hello.

steps.speaker: Oneiromancer
steps.text: How's it going?

steps.player: Any chance you have a vial you can give me?

steps.speaker: Oneiromancer
steps.text: And the magic word is?

steps.player: Erm. Lunar?

steps.speaker: Oneiromancer
steps.text: Oh dear, of course not!

steps.player: Oh, sorry. PLEASE!

steps.speaker: Oneiromancer
steps.text: Now that wasn't difficult, was it?
If the player has no inventory space:

steps.player: Apparently so. I don't have any free space to take a vial. I'll be back in a second.

dream-mentoring-talking-to-cyrisus-next-.text: With the potion in the inventory:

steps.player: Okay, I have the Potion of Shared Dreaming; now what?

steps.speaker: Cyrisus
steps.text: Best you light the brazier with a tinderbox first, then give me the potion.

steps.player: Yes, let's go!
Not yet.

steps.speaker: Cyrisus
steps.text: Let me know when you're ready.

dream-mentoring-talking-to-cyrisus-next-.text: Without the potion in the inventory:

steps.player: Okay, so we need to make the Potion of Shared Dreaming.

steps.speaker: Cyrisus
steps.text: Yes. Water, goutweed and one astral rune all in that...

steps.speaker: Cyrisus
steps.text: Wait, where did you put the vial?

steps.player: Oops.

steps.speaker: Cyrisus
steps.text: Ask the Oneiromancer nicely, I'm sure she will have another.

dream-mentoring-talking-to-cyrisus-next-.text: With an empty dream vial in the inventory:

steps.player: Okay, so we need to make the Potion of Shared Dreaming.

steps.speaker: Cyrisus
steps.text: Yes. Water, goutweed and one astral rune all in that tiny vial.

dream-mentoring-talking-to-the-oneiroman.speaker: Oneiromancer
dream-mentoring-talking-to-the-oneiroman.text: Hello there. What do you want to talk about?

steps.player: Hello.

steps.speaker: Oneiromancer
steps.text: How's it going?

steps.player: Very well so far, we have the Potion of Shared Dreaming.
We just need to visit Cyrisus's dreams and come to a solution.

steps.speaker: Oneiromancer
steps.text: I like your spirit!

cyrisus-courage.player: Don't ask me, it's your dream!
You must really be afraid of combat!
What do you mean 'why'? This huge creature must symbolise your fears!

cyrisus-courage.speaker: Cyrisus
cyrisus-courage.text: I'm guessing we're going to be fighting my fears.

cyrisus-courage.speaker: Cyrisus
cyrisus-courage.text: I'm still scared. Show me how you fight, and I should gain courage.

cyrisus-courage-leaving-the-dream.prompt: You'll have to fight from the beginning.

cyrisus-courage-talking-to-the-oneiroman.speaker: Oneiromancer
cyrisus-courage-talking-to-the-oneiroman.text: Hello there. What do you want to talk about?

steps.player: Hello.

steps.speaker: Oneiromancer
steps.text: How's it going?

steps.player: Not bad. We've been into the dream, but we are yet to conquer it.

steps.speaker: Oneiromancer
steps.text: Very good.

steps.player: We're probably going to need more of that potion.

steps.speaker: Oneiromancer
steps.text: Perhaps Cyrisus can help you out there, he's a resourceful chap.

cyrisus-courage-re-entering-the-dream-af.player: We need to go into the dream again.

cyrisus-courage-re-entering-the-dream-af.speaker: Cyrisus
cyrisus-courage-re-entering-the-dream-af.text: It looks like there is a little potion left in the bottle.

cyrisus-courage-trying-to-re-enter-with-.player: We need to go into the dream again.

cyrisus-courage-trying-to-re-enter-with-.speaker: Cyrisus
cyrisus-courage-trying-to-re-enter-with-.text: That may be the case, but you need to light the brazier with a tinderbox first.

steps.speaker: Cyrisus
steps.text: Oh, I can't attack. I'm too afraid!

steps.speaker: Cyrisus
steps.text: I'm building up my courage. I'll attack soon.

steps.speaker: Cyrisus
steps.text: Fight to give me courage.

steps.speaker: Cyrisus
steps.text: I don't know if I can do this.

cyrisus-courage-defeating-the-illusive.player: Now, now, now! Cyrisus! Get it!
Back to reality, I suppose, and on to the Oneiromancer!

finishing-up-talking-to-cyrisus-after-co.speaker: Cyrisus
finishing-up-talking-to-cyrisus-after-co.text: No, WE did it. Thank you [player name]. It really is appreciated.

finishing-up-talking-to-cyrisus-after-co.player: Ah, no worries, it was fun.

finishing-up-talking-to-cyrisus-after-co.speaker: Cyrisus
finishing-up-talking-to-cyrisus-after-co.text: Well I'm not sure I enjoyed almost getting killed, but yes, it was good.

finishing-up-talking-to-the-oneiromancer.speaker: Oneiromancer
finishing-up-talking-to-the-oneiromancer.text: Hello there. What do you want to talk about?

steps.player: We did it!

steps.speaker: Oneiromancer
steps.text: You did?

steps.speaker: Cyrisus
steps.text: Yes, I've conquered my fear of combat.

steps.player: We beat those monsters well and good, didn't we?

steps.speaker: Cyrisus
steps.text: We sure did! I was very afraid to start off with, but once I saw how you dealt with combat I felt sure I could do it too.

steps.speaker: Oneiromancer
steps.text: Oh, I'm pleased. Congratulations.

steps.speaker: Cyrisus
steps.text: Thank you [player name]. I really couldn't have done it without your help. Please, let me pass some of my knowledge onto you.
If the player's inventory is full:

steps.speaker: Cyrisus
steps.text: Ah, sorry but could you do me a favour and clear some inventory space first?

steps.player: Oh, okay.
Okay, in what way?

steps.speaker: Cyrisus
steps.text: On my last visit to this island I spent a good while with the Moon Clan. It seems it isn't all that impossible to instantly transfer knowledge to one another.

steps.player: Huh?

steps.speaker: Cyrisus
steps.text: I shall just use lunar magic to pass some information onto you.

steps.speaker: Cyrisus
steps.text: Just keep your mind blank, relax and hold still.

steps.player: Ooooh. That was a weird sensation.
I must admit, I do feel enlightened already. Thank you!

steps.speaker: Cyrisus
steps.text: My pleasure. And I best be off, I think I am going to put my courage to the test! I have a new goal to reach - the ultimate warrior!

steps.player: Be careful!

steps.speaker: Cyrisus
steps.text: I will. I'll see you around, I'm sure!
Congratulations! Quest complete!
